You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How many dollars did each pack of strawberry gum cost? Suzie bought four packs of fruit-flavored gum. Suzie bought two packs of strawberry gum. Suzie paid $2 for one pack of grape gum. Suzie paid half as much for one small pack of green apple gum as she paid for the pack of grape gum. Suzie paid $7 for all four packs of gum.
